items.title: CHANEL Culture Fund ประกาศความร่วมมือกับ Dib Bangkok เปิดตัว Chanel Gateway Commission
items.summary: Chanel Culture Fund announced a partnership with independent art space Dib Bangkok to launch the Chanel Gateway Commission, its first art partnership in Southeast Asia. The inaugural commission goes to Thai artist Nawin Nuthong for 'Project 147,' a multimedia installation blending Thai folklore with interactive gaming. Chanel's Yana Peel cited the brand's interest in Thailand's cultural community. This is competitor (Chanel) cultural-diplomacy activity directly targeting the Thai/SEA luxury audience, a space Gucci has not matched locally.

items.title: CHANEL Culture Fund จับมือกับ Dib Bangkok ร่วมทำโปรเจ็กต์พิเศษ CHANEL Gateway Commission
items.summary: Thai-language corroboration of the Chanel Gateway Commission announcement with Dib Bangkok, supporting Thai artist Nawin Nuthong. Frames the move as Chanel deepening ties with Thailand's contemporary art and creative scene, positioning the brand culturally beyond retail in a market Gucci also competes in via ambassadors (Davika Hoorne, Gulf Kanawut).

items.title: Chanel and Dior Are Moving Into New Cultural Spaces
items.summary: English-language roundup covering Chanel's Bangkok art commission alongside Dior's A24 film/theatre partnership in New York, framing both LVMH/Chanel houses as pivoting luxury marketing toward cultural patronage rather than product campaigns. No Gucci mention in the piece, underscoring that peers are diversifying brand-building formats in SEA while Gucci's regional activity remains centered on store events and ambassador appearances.
